question: In an election between two candidates, 20% of the total votes were declared invalid. The winning candidate received 40% of the valid votes and secured 1,60,000 more valid votes than the runner-up, who received 32% of the valid votes. Find the total number of valid votes.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in % = 40% − 32% = 8%

8% of valid votes = 160000

Valid votes = 160000 ÷ 0.08

= 2000000

**∴ Answer = 20,00,000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Winner = 40% of valid votes, Runner-up = 32%, Difference = 160000

**Formula used:**

Difference = (Percentage difference) × Total valid votes

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let total valid votes = V

⇒ Winner votes = 0.40V

⇒ Runner-up votes = 0.32V

⇒ Difference = 0.40V − 0.32V = 0.08V

⇒ 0.08V = 160000

⇒ V = 160000 ÷ 0.08

⇒ V = 2000000

**∴ The total number of valid votes is 20,00,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Difference

Difference in values = (% difference) × total

Quick Trick

Always subtract percentages first to simplify.

Decimal Conversion

8% = 0.08

Check

Ensure difference matches given value.
